_comment: Applied to the real prod bucket ammariprod-cdy2yf (Cloudeka, endpoint https://kencana.basic.box.cloudeka.id, region kencana — docs/plans/prod-deploy.md §4 step 7). This is the ONE prod bucket: it also holds nightly encrypted Postgres backups under backups/, which deliberately has NO statement here and must stay private (verified by an anonymous curl expecting 403 — docs/plans/prod-deploy.md §4 step 16, §7's go-live checklist). Prod uses no S3_KEY_PREFIX (unlike dev's shared bucket, split by local/ vs dev/) — see deploy-prod/env/admin.env.example's comment on that var; a non-empty prefix here would silently break public image serving, since these Resource ARNs assume keys sit at the bucket root. Public GetObject is scoped to exactly the prefixes apps/web's storefront renders publicly (products/* and content/*) plus healthcheck/* (packages/storage's storage:check script). Everything else — including backups/ — stays private. Apply with `pnpm --filter @ammari/storage policy:apply -- --env prod` (see docs/deploy-prod.md). This _comment key is stripped by the apply script before calling PutBucketPolicy.
